title: Compressed Simulation-Based Inference: Neural Posterior Estimation for Massive Data via Low-Dimensional Sketches
abstract: arXiv:2611.21286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural posterior estimation (NPE) is a popular Bayesian simulation-based inference (SBI) approach that uses neural networks trained on simulated data--parameter pairs to approximate the posterior given a user-chosen prior. For high-dimensional observations, NPE methods typically approximate the conditional density of the parameter given a user-chosen or learned summary statistic, rather than the entire dataset, due to the curse of dimensionality. However, both approaches face challenges: hand-crafting good summaries for complex models requires considerable effort from scientists, while learning them from massive datasets can be prohibitively computationally expensive. To address these challenges, we propose approximating the conditional density of a parameter given low-dimensional sketches of the data. translated_title: 压缩式基于模拟的推断：利用低维草图实现海量数据的神经后验估计
translated_abstract: 神经后验估计（NPE）是一种流行的贝叶斯基于模拟的推断（SBI）方法，它使用在模拟数据-参数对上训练的神经网络，在给定用户选择的先验条件下近似后验分布。对于高维观测数据，由于维数灾难，NPE方法通常近似参数在用户选择或学习得到的摘要统计量条件下的条件密度，而非整个数据集。然而，这两种方法都面临挑战：为复杂模型手工设计良好的摘要统计量需要科学家付出大量努力，而从海量数据集中学习摘要统计量的计算代价可能过于高昂。为解决这些挑战，我们提出近似参数在数据低维草图条件下的条件密度。我们证明，对于一个具有 $p$ 维参数的模型，仅需 $2p+1$ 个随机草图即可保证后验一致性。我们比较……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出压缩式基于模拟的推断方法，通过仅用 $2p+1$ 个随机低维草图即可实现后验一致性，从而避免手工设计摘要统计量的困难和学习摘要的高昂计算成本，实现海量数据下的神经后验估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes compressed simulation-based inference, showing that only $2p+1$ random low-dimensional sketches of the data suffice for posterior consistency, thereby enabling neural posterior estimation on massive data while avoiding both the effort of hand-crafted summary statistics and the prohibitive cost of learning summaries from large datasets.
